items.text: Developing BSP software for porting device trees, Linux drivers, and integrating them with the OS.
Using probe tools and reviewing hardware designs to solve problems.
Building Jetpack, GStreamer, Jetson Multimedia APIs, etc.
Working closely with hardware/platform design teams.
Addressing requests based on customer needs.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Knowledge of the Linux kernel environment.
Programming experience in C, Python, and scripting languages.
Experience in cross-compiling kernels and applications.

description.text:
What you will be involved in:
* Developing BSP software for porting device trees, Linux drivers, and integrating them with the OS.
* Using probe tools and reviewing hardware designs to solve problems.
* Building Jetpack, GStreamer, Jetson Multimedia APIs, etc.
* Working closely with hardware/platform design teams.
* Addressing requests based on customer needs.
What we need to have:
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Knowledge of the Linux kernel environment.
* Programming experience in C, Python, and scripting languages.
It would be nice to have:
* Experience in cross-compiling kernels and applications.
* Experience with ARM-based architecture.
* Experience in porting camera BSP (GMSL).
